tools.name: verify_company_claims
tools.description: Resolve a company, compare supported claims with current company evidence, preserve a proof record, and optionally monitor verified claims for change. This call consumes normal CompanyProof claim credits and writes to the account evidence ledger.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find ranked CompanyProof company matches by name, registration number, VAT/tax identifier or ticker, optionally narrowed by subdivision and city/state. This read-only operation requires an active CompanyProof evaluation or paid plan and live account access, and consumes one shared claim credit.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a CompanyProof company profile and enrichment payload by the opaque company ID returned from search_companies. This read-only operation requires an active CompanyProof evaluation or paid plan and live account access, and consumes one shared claim credit.
